uniqueness.title: Uniqueness Of Athos Fish Collagen Peptide
features: High Protein Content: More than 97% protein, delivering high purity and nutritional value.
Complete Amino Acid Profile: Contains all amino acids, with very high content of Glycine, Proline and Hydroxyproline (GPH) ≥ 40%, makes it Collagen Tri-Peptide (CTP).
Odourless and Tasteless: Completely odourless, tasteless and 100% soluble in water.
Ultra Low Molecular Weight: Enhances bioavailability and absorption significantly.
Clinically Approved with brand name Ficolla
Fish Source Only Facility: Manufactured exclusively in a Fish Source Only Facility, ensuring zero cross-contamination from other sources.
Globally Accepted Quality: Accredited by globally recognized certification bodies.

fishGelatin.introTitle: Athos Collagen Pvt. Ltd. is leading Manufacturer and Exporter of Fish gelatin from India
fishGelatin.introDesc1: Designed by nature, Fish gelatin delivers clean functionality with high biocompatibility, making it suitable across food, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and biomedical industries.
fishGelatin.introDesc2: Fish gelatin is increasingly positioned as a next-generation alternative, offering broader market access, higher consumer acceptance, and alignment with global clean-label and sustainability trends.

gellingPower.title: Gelling Power
gellingPower.description: Advanced thermo-reversible gelation allows precise control over texture from firm structures to smooth, melt-in-mouth experiences.

formingAbility.title: Forming Ability
formingAbility.description: Transforms liquid systems into thin, durable films ideal for coatings, encapsulation, and protective barriers.

emulsionStability.title: Reliable Emulsion Stability
emulsionStability.description: Ensures uniform mixing of oil and water phases, improving consistency, stability, and shelf life.

bindingAdhesion.title: Binding & Adhesion
bindingAdhesion.description: Enhances structural integrity by binding ingredients efficiently in solid and semi-solid formulations.

clarityPurity.title: Clarity & Purity
clarityPurity.description: Delivers transparent, clean solutions with no impact on taste, color, or formulation integrity.

digestibilityCleanLabel.title: Digestibility & Clean Label
digestibilityCleanLabel.description: Naturally derived protein with excellent digestibility, supporting modern clean-label product demands.

foodIndustry.name: Foods
foodIndustry.description: Fish gelatin enhances functional foods, confectionery, desserts, and snacks, while providing gelling, thickening, and stabilizing properties in formulations.
applications: gelling Texturizer and Dairy Products Agent

cosmeticsSkincare.name: Cosmeceutical
cosmeticsSkincare.description: Fish gelatin enhances creams, masks, and serums by providing natural thickening, gelling, and film-forming properties for smooth, stable, and luxurious formulations.

biomedicalApplications.name: Biomedical
biomedicalApplications.description: Fish collagen supports tissue engineering, wound healing, and regenerative medicine by providing a biocompatible, bioactive protein scaffold.

pharmaIndustry.name: Pharmaceutical
pharmaIndustry.description: Fish gelatin is a key ingredient in pharmaceutical capsules, tablets, and soft gels, providing a natural, biocompatible, and stable coating.
